_**User (2026-04-20 21:22:05Z)**_

What personas did you include in the new user stories?

---

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

Three persona layers, seven distinct personas:

**Applicant / First-Time User** (US-O1–US-O8)
- The primary onboarding actor — a capable professional setting up CV Builder for the first time, wanting to import from whatever source materials they have.

**UI/UX Expert** (US-O9–US-O10)
- Evaluates whether the onboarding flow is clear, recoverable, and error-tolerant — following the same evaluation-criteria format used in the existing `user-story-ux-expert.md`.

**Master CV Curator** (US-O11–US-O12)
- Evaluates post-import data quality: completeness check after creation (US-O11) and conflict resolution when merging overlapping sources (US-O12) — extending the existing `user-story-master-cv-curator.md` persona into the onboarding context.

**First-Time User** (US-F4, added to `user-story-first-time-user.md`)
- The existing first-time user persona, extended with a story specifically about encountering the app with no master CV present and being guided to the onboarding flow.

Notably absent (by design, as they don't have a direct stake in initial master CV creation): hiring manager, HR/ATS, resume expert, persuasion expert, power user, accessibility specialist, recruiter-ops, trust/compliance, and graphical designer. Those personas are relevant once the master CV exists and job applications begin.
